findings.title: One concept, three names: the window says group, the CLI, MCP, notifications, backend errors and the brand pack say project, and every surface also says pool
evidence: switchboard project --help (installed 0.6.80): every subcommand names the group by --pool
findings.current: Nav and dialog: "Groups", "+ New group", "Group name"; the same dialog's backend refusal: "Name the project." / "Add at least one project folder." / "Project not found."; tray notification: "Folder added to a project"; CLI: "No projects. `switchboard project save` reserves accounts for a project's folders."; MCP title "Move a repository to another project" over a description that says "into another group"; README: "Give agents on API keys a key per project | ... a key per group". terminology.md defines Pool and never Group; strings.md still registers "+ New project", "Give a project its own accounts".
findings.proposal: Add to terminology.md: Group = a set of projects (repositories) with accounts of its own (since SB-146); Project = one repository with its worktrees and clones; Pool = internal id, never shown alone to a person. Then rename in one pass: backend refusals "Name the group.", "Add at least one folder to the group.", "Group not found."; notifications "Folder added to a group" / «Папка добавлена в группу»; MCP titles and descriptions; CLI empty-state "No groups. `switchboard project save` creates one." (keep the command name, explain it once in --help: "project: manage groups"); README row "a key per group".

findings.title: Error sends the person to the wrong page: the OpenRouter key moved to Tokens, the backend still says Agents
findings.current: No OpenRouter key is saved. Add one under Agents. / Choose a model for this launch, or set the default model of the OpenRouter key under Agents.
findings.proposal: No OpenRouter key is saved. Add one under Tokens. / Choose a model for this launch, or set the key's default model under Tokens. RU: «Ключ OpenRouter не сохранён. Добавьте его во вкладке «Токены».» (the window already has this sentence at src/main.ts:1612; reuse it).

findings.title: The CLI and MCP print raw backend errors that the window rewrites; the person in a terminal gets the worse sentence
findings.current: CLI shows "Credential expired; reauthenticate this account", "Account is disabled", "Label or pool is invalid", "Unsafe account home.", "Session state invalid.", "Keychain unavailable.", "Control metadata unavailable.", "Backup identity mismatch.", "Installation file unreadable."; the window shows e.g. "This credential has expired. Sign in to this account again."
findings.proposal: Rule: one sentence per failure, owned by the runtime. Move the coreErrors rewrites (about 90 entries in src/adapter.ts) into the Rust messages so CLI, MCP and window print the same text that says what happened and what to do; keep adapter.ts as a safety allowlist only.

findings.title: Retired action words (capture, native activation, profile) still reach the person in English
findings.current: Native activation requires a Claude OAuth profile. / Capture or import this profile before native activation. / No current Claude sign-in found. Sign in with the official CLI, then capture again. / The local CLI profile is incomplete or inconsistent. Complete official sign-in, then capture the account again.
findings.proposal: Use the current actions, as the Russian already does: "Switching Claude Code needs a Claude account signed in with OAuth." / "Add this account (In use now, Add to Switchboard), then switch." / "No Claude sign-in found. Sign in with claude /login, then add the account again."

findings.title: Errors that do not say what happened or what to do next
findings.current: The operation could not be completed. Check your input and native credential storage access, then retry. / Account saved; isolated login cleanup needs attention. / Session state invalid. Inspect the managed home. / Switchboard could not record the hand-over. / Could not remove the login item. / Native account source unavailable.
findings.proposal: Fallback: "Switchboard could not finish this action. Nothing was changed. Retry; if it repeats, open Activity for the recorded cause." Cleanup: "The account was saved. A temporary sign-in folder was left behind; Switchboard removes it before the next sign-in." Session state: "Switchboard could not read this account's session folder. Close the account's Terminal sessions, then retry." Hand-over: "... Check that the app's data folder is writable, then retry." Login item: "... Remove Fabric Switchboard from the system's login items yourself."

findings.title: Rotation and automatic switching name the same feature; the Russian uses the forbidden «ротация»
findings.current: Window: 17 strings say "automatic switching", 10 say "rotation" ("Rotation is off.", "Rotation still runs.", "Claude Code rotation requires OAuth accounts..."); MCP titles "Automatic rotation" / "Set automatic rotation" with "hysteresis"; RU: «...не выбирает его при ротации.»
findings.proposal: Window and MCP titles: "automatic switching" everywhere ("Automatic switching is off.", "Automatic switching still runs."); MCP may keep field names (hysteresis) but its title and prose say "automatic switching" and "headroom". RU 1212/1216: «...не продлевает его вход и не переключается на него, в том числе автоматически.»

findings.title: Internal ids and jargon in the automatic switching controls: pool slug, target, policy
findings.current: Stop {pool} / Edit {provider} · {pool} · {target}… / New policy… / Automatic switching stopped for this provider, pool and target. / Configure one provider, pool and target. Fresh eligible accounts stay within this boundary; no eligible account means hold. / Pool · {pool}
findings.proposal: Show the group's name or "Default" instead of the pool slug (the account list already does this with "Group · {name}"): "Stop in {group}", "Edit {provider} in {group} ({where})…", "New automatic switching…", "Automatic switching stopped for {provider} in {group}.", "Choose the provider and group it watches. It moves only to a fresh account in the same group; with none, the current account stays."

findings.title: Em dashes in user-facing text (operator rule): CLI help, CLI output, MCP descriptions, README.ru
findings.current: ran out of its limit on another account — of the same provider / terminal on stdin and stdout) — for an embedded console / when its accounts run out — per machine / where the setup stands — each step done / the saved OpenRouter key instead — for a session script's / CLI empty cell "—" / MCP "and state — starting, running", "the chain that applies — the workflow's own" / README.ru «**Add account** — официальный вход»
findings.proposal: Replace with a colon, a full stop or parentheses ("...on another account: of the same provider...", "...stdout), for an embedded console...", "state: starting, running, ended or unknown"). CLI empty cell: "-" or "none" (the window uses "–" en dash). Extend scripts/check-locale.mjs's U+2014 check to clap doc comments, MCP descriptions and README*.md (a failing grep in ./scripts/check.sh).

findings.title: Backlog ids (SB-nnn) printed in --help and MCP tool descriptions
findings.current: --also  SB-146: add it to this group and keep it in its other groups / Organizations accounts belong to (SB-158): ... / What the proxy relayed (SB-145): ... (36 help lines, 18 distinct ids in the installed 0.6.80 --help tree)
findings.proposal: Drop the ids from `///` lines clap shows and from MCP descriptions; keep them in `//` comments next to the code. Add a help test that fails on /SB-\d+/ in any about or help text.

findings.title: Russian loading and waiting states in the first person, against the pack's own rule (one form per state, Switchboard never «мы»)
findings.current: Ищем агентов для программирования на этом компьютере… / Загружаем список моделей OpenRouter… / Ищу репозитории… / Читаю настройки Codex… / Читаю статистику… / Читаю ключи… / Ждём PassionCode.ai в браузере…
findings.proposal: Поиск агентов на этом компьютере… / Загрузка моделей OpenRouter… / Поиск репозиториев… / Загрузка настроек Codex… / Загрузка статистики… / Загрузка ключей… / Ожидание ответа PassionCode.ai в браузере… Add a check-locale rule that rejects a value starting with a first-person verb (Читаю|Ищу|Ищем|Ждём|Загружаем).

findings.title: strings.md (SB-66) is out of date both ways: it registers retired strings and misses most current ones
findings.current: Registered but no longer shown: "+ New project", "Give a project its own accounts", "Project name", "Create project", "Save project", "No projects yet", "Step {n} of 5" (now "Step {step} of {total}"), "Signing in to Claude Code" (now "Signing in to {provider}"), "Version {current} is the latest..." (now {version}), "{n} accounts restored · {k} already here", "Limit reached · until {time}", "Update check finished.", "Next managed request". Shown but not registered: 915 of 1243 interface keys, whole surfaces with none: Organizations and PassionCode.ai connect (SB-158/159), Tokens and group keys (SB-144), Statistics (SB-145/147/157), Repositories on disk (SB-135), Codex in group folders (SB-143), groups (SB-146), used on another machine (SB-175), session context (SB-110/111). docs/brand/README.md:6 still says localization is absent.
findings.proposal: Regenerate the registry from `node scripts/check-locale.mjs --list`, grouped by surface with its SCN id, mark retired strings under Retired, and add a gate step that fails when a key is neither registered nor listed as retired. Fix README.md:6 (Russian ships since SB-76).

findings.title: README.ru describes an older product and mixes English UI names and jargon; both READMEs show a 0.6.13 screenshot
findings.current: «| Разделять рабочие и личные аккаунты | Пулы, правила проектов и отдельные профили сессий |» (no groups, Statistics, Tokens, Organizations, which README.md lists); «**Add account** ... **Select** ... **Check usage**» while the Russian window says «Добавить аккаунт», «Выбрать», «Проверить использование»; «Задайте label и pool», «один управляемый home», «Постоянный credential находится в OS vault, но isolated-режим...»
findings.proposal: Bring README.ru.md to parity with README.md's task table, name buttons as the Russian window shows them, replace label/pool/home/credential/OS vault/isolated-режим with название, группа, домашняя папка сессии, учётные данные, системное хранилище, изолированная сессия. Replace the 0.6.13 screenshot with a current one (channel github-readme asks for a current screenshot).

findings.title: "Tokens" names a page of API keys, while Statistics uses tokens for usage counts
findings.current: Nav and title "Tokens"; subtitle "API keys agents run on: the machine's, and one per group."; section "OpenRouter keys"; Statistics "Tokens per day", "tokens on average"
findings.proposal: Name the page "API keys" (RU «Ключи API»), and keep "tokens" only for counted usage. Update the pointer "... are under API keys." and "Open API keys".

findings.title: Personal is one key in three grammatical slots; the Russian help names an option that does not exist
findings.current: Option «Личные» next to help «...а при выборе «Личная» только на личных.» and «Автоматически: личный»
findings.proposal: Split the key by context: "Personal accounts" (filter, «Личные»), "Personal" as an organization choice («Личные аккаунты»), and make the help quote the option exactly: «...а при выборе «Личные аккаунты» только на личных.» «Автоматически: личные аккаунты».

findings.title: Native notifications use macOS wording on every platform and a second name for Restart to update
findings.current: Restart to finish updating / Fabric Switchboard {version} is ready. Restart from the menu-bar icon, or it starts by itself at a quiet moment. / Allow it in System Settings → General → Login Items.
findings.proposal: Pass the platform in: "its icon in the notification area" on Windows and Linux (as the window already does), and a per-platform login items path (Windows: Settings → Apps → Startup). Title "Restart to update" to match the tray item.

findings.title: Stale and jargon strings left in the window vocabulary
findings.current: Terminal launch is currently supported on macOS and Windows only. (Linux is supported; the runtime now says so) / Choose an existing project directory. ("Project directory" is retired in strings.md:69) / Loading your workbench
findings.proposal: Delete the dead macOS-and-Windows sentence from safeErrors; runtime "Choose an existing folder."; "Loading Switchboard" (the Russian already says «Загрузка Switchboard»).

findings.title: Russian calques and transliterations that read as machine translation
findings.current: ворктри / Этот аккаунт относится к другой организации, чем группа. / ...или укажите любой id. / ...введённые вручную id по-прежнему работают.
findings.proposal: рабочие копии (git worktree) on first use, then «рабочие копии»; «Этот аккаунт относится к другой организации, не к организации группы.»; «идентификатор» instead of id in running text.

notes: No English string shown without t() was found in the window: every literal goes through t(), plural() or the adapter's verbatim/mapped sets; CLI and MCP are English-only by design.
Window strings carry no em dash (check-locale enforces it); the en dashes in src/main.ts:1585-1651 are empty-cell placeholders, not dashes between words.
